'''Roa''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] who served aboard the first [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], he participated in the surgery to save [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] life after she was injured in the [[attack on the first Death Star]]. He had a laconic sense of humor and was sometimes unmindful of the treacherous nature of employment under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]].
